This page documents how the four `nflendzone*` repositories operate as one system:

- [`nflendzonePipeline`](https://github.com/TylerPollard410/nflendzonePipeline)
- [`nflendzoneData`](https://github.com/TylerPollard410/nflendzoneData)
- [`nflendzoneModel`](https://github.com/TylerPollard410/nflendzoneModel)
- [`nflendzoneApp`](https://github.com/TylerPollard410/nflendzoneApp)

All raw football data enters through the `nflverse` ecosystem (primarily `nflreadr`, `nflfastR`, and `nflseedR`).

## Repository Responsibilities

| Repository | Primary role | Upstream inputs | Downstream outputs |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nflendzonePipeline` | ETL, feature engineering, release publishing | `nflverse` game, play-by-play, and stat data | release assets in `nflendzoneData` (`team_features`, `game_model`, etc.) |
| `nflendzoneData` | release-only artifact storage | pipeline and model outputs | versioned release tags consumed by app/model workflows |
| `nflendzoneModel` | Bayesian Stan modeling package + fit/predict workflow | schedule/game data + model-ready features | posterior summaries and CmdStan outputs to `nflendzoneData` |
| `nflendzoneApp` | Shiny/Rhino UI for standings and probabilities | `nflverse` schedules + `nflendzoneData` summaries | interactive tables, prediction plots, cover/total probabilities |

## End-to-End Flow

```text
nflverse raw data
  -> nflendzonePipeline (compute + feature engineering)
  -> nflendzoneData release tags (feature/model tables)
  -> nflendzoneModel fit + generated quantities
  -> nflendzoneData release tags (team strength, result, fit/gq artifacts)
  -> nflendzoneApp (summary ingestion + draw regeneration + UI)
```

## Artifact Contract

### Core ETL tags (pipeline-managed)

- `nfl_stats_week_team_regpost`, `nfl_stats_week_player_regpost`
- `nfl_stats_season_team_regpost`, `nfl_stats_season_player_regpost`
- `season_standings`, `weekly_standings`
- `elo`, `srs`, `epa`, `scores`, `series`, `turnover`, `redzone`
- `team_features`, `game_features`, `team_model`, `game_model`

### Model tags (model/pipeline-managed)

- `team_strength_filter`, `league_hfa_filter`, `result_filter`
- `team_strength_predict`, `league_hfa_predict`, `result_predict`
- `team_strength_fit`, `team_strength_gq`
- `team_strength_negbinom_summary` (app-facing summary artifact)

### Odds tags

- `historic_events`

## Operations and Cadence

- `nflendzonePipeline/.github/workflows/update_data.yml` runs scheduled ETL updates during season months.
- `nflendzonePipeline/.github/workflows/update_team_strength_model.yml` runs the team-strength workflow weekly in-season.
- `nflendzonePipeline/.github/workflows/update_README.yml` refreshes weekly report visuals.

As of this audit (February 15, 2026), the GitHub API `pushed_at` timestamps were:

- `nflendzonePipeline`: `2026-02-14T08:33:11Z`
- `nflendzoneData`: `2025-12-28T04:06:14Z`
- `nflendzoneModel`: `2026-01-10T11:13:25Z`
- `nflendzoneApp`: `2026-02-09T01:13:23Z`

## Important Integration Pattern

The app does not require full posterior draws in production artifacts. Instead, it ingests summary-level model outputs (for example, `team_strength_negbinom_summary`) and reconstructs stochastic draws in memory with `rvar_rng` for fast interactive probability calculations.

This reduces release size and deploy-time data transfer while preserving probabilistic UX.
